title: Straps are falling apart...never stays in place
text:
Straps are falling apart...never stays in place. I think I would have preferred the stretch cover better because this doesn't stay in place. I have to fix it every time my husband sits in it. Come to think of it..it's ok for me. I got it to protect the new chair from my messy husband and shedding dog. It seems to work when I can get it to stay in place, but just be prepared to straighten it up all the time!
Also watch the straps. They don't stay properly and are already falling apart and it's less than 2 months old (Xmas present) Do not waste your money on this. Get the stretch covers!
